_comment: Module-size ceiling read by .claude/hooks/guard-code-standards.py. A Python file under a framework repo's src/ or tests/ that an edit leaves above `ceiling` lines, and longer than it was, is refused: new code goes in a new sibling module. A file already above the ceiling may shrink, never grow. `exempt` lists files that cannot be split because their source is inlined verbatim into generated projects; adding to it needs Jon's approval.

exempt.reason: Inlined verbatim into generated projects by generators/agents/inlined_runtime.py; a split would change the emitted source.
Inlined verbatim into scripts/zitadel/apply_provisioning.py by generators/compose/_zitadel_wiring.py; a split would change the emitted source.
